[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant offered to help optimize user’s travel habits and reduce travel time with various suggestions.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant highlighted features of Los Angeles International Airport (LAX) that may improve the passenger experience, including automated check-in, TSA Precheck, LAX-it for ride-hailing, and the airport app.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant noted that LAX is undergoing modernization projects to improve passenger experience, including a new midfield satellite concourse and an automated people mover.
